name: ch17_part1_nationalism_unity_liberation
prompt: Vibrant editorial political cartoon in rich warm colors showing the meaning and dual power of nationalism. In the center, diverse people holding hands in patriotic unity under a national tricolor flag, breaking colonial chains of oppression. Heading 'राष्ट्रवाद: एकता और मुक्ति की भावना' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail, educational poster style.

name: ch17_part2_shared_beliefs_imagined_community
prompt: Editorial political cartoon illustrating the concept of a Nation as a Shared Belief and Imagined Community (Benedict Anderson). A diverse group of millions of citizens across mountains, plains, and coasts connected by invisible golden threads of shared belief and brotherhood. Heading 'राष्ट्र: एक साझा विश्वास और कल्पित समुदाय' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail, warm poster style.

name: ch17_part3_nation_vs_state
prompt: Educational political cartoon comparing Nation (emotional cultural unity of people) versus State (legal fortress of Constitution, law, government, and sovereignty). Clear Hindi labels 'राष्ट्र: भावनात्मक एकता' and 'राज्य: कानूनी संप्रभुता'. High detail.

name: ch17_part4_shared_history
prompt: Inspiring political cartoon showing shared historical memories of freedom struggle—Dandi March, 1857 revolt, and sacrifice of freedom fighters depicted on an open historical scroll inspiring modern Indian students and citizens. Heading 'साझी ऐतिहासिक स्मृतियां और स्वाधीनता संग्राम' in bold Devanagari Hindi.

name: ch17_part5_shared_homeland
prompt: Vibrant landscape cartoon of India showing sacred emotional connection to the homeland from the Himalayas to the Indian Ocean, with sacred rivers Ganga-Yamuna, lush fields, and soldiers protecting frontiers. Heading 'मातृभूमि का भावनात्मक जुड़ाव'.

name: ch17_part6_political_ideals
prompt: Educational cartoon illustration showing 4 glowing pillars of modern Indian nationalism: 1. Democracy (लोकतंत्र), 2. Secularism (पंथनिरपेक्षता), 3. Social Justice (सामाजिक न्याय), 4. Rule of Law (विधि का शासन), supporting the Indian Constitution. Crisp Hindi labels.

name: ch17_part7_shared_political_identity
prompt: Empowering political cartoon of diverse Indian citizens from different states standing equal before a ballot box, holding voter identity cards with the message 'साझी राजनीतिक पहचान: हम सब एक हैं'. Warm patriotic colors.

name: ch17_part8_self_determination
prompt: Historical political cartoon showing the principle of National Self-Determination (Woodrow Wilson 1919), where communities gain freedom from imperial rule to govern themselves democratically. Heading 'राष्ट्रीय आत्मनिर्णय का अधिकार' in Devanagari Hindi.

name: ch17_part9_limits_one_culture_one_state
prompt: Thoughtful editorial cartoon showing the dangerous limits of 'one culture, one state' theory—breaking land into endless isolated tiny cages versus a harmonious multicultural garden of coexistence. Heading 'एक संस्कृति-एक राज्य की सीमाएं'.

name: ch17_part10_ethnic_nationalism_dangers
prompt: Serious editorial political cartoon showing the dark dangers of narrow ethnic nationalism (hatred, discrimination, walls) contrasted against the bright sun of inclusive constitutional democracy. Heading 'संकीर्ण जातीय राष्ट्रवाद के खतरे'.

name: ch17_part11_yugoslavia_ussr_disintegration_clean
prompt: Clear comparative political cartoon showing the historical lesson of national disintegration. On the left under dark storm clouds, broken maps of USSR and Yugoslavia crumble with label 'जातीय संघर्ष और विभाजन (1991)'. On the right under bright sunshine, diverse citizens stand united in peace holding hands with a dove and the Constitution with label 'सहिष्णुता और लोकतंत्र'. Heading 'ऐतिहासिक विभाजन से सीख: सहिष्णुता ही एकता की शक्ति' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail, poster style.

name: ch17_part12_indian_pluralism
prompt: Magnificent vibrant cartoon celebrating Indian pluralist nationalism—people of diverse languages (Tamil, Bengali, Hindi, Punjabi, Marathi) and cultures celebrating together under the national flag. Heading 'भारतीय राष्ट्रवाद: विविधता में एकता'.

name: ch17_part13_tagore_humanism
prompt: Poetic and philosophical cartoon of Rabindranath Tagore in Shantiniketan teaching world students that true patriotism must serve universal humanism and world peace. Quote 'मानवता पर देशभक्ति को विजयी नहीं होने दूंगा' in elegant Devanagari Hindi.

name: ch17_part14_civic_vs_ethnic
prompt: Educational balance scale comparing Civic Constitutional Nationalism (welcoming, equal rights, rule of law) versus Ethnic Nationalism (exclusion, narrow bias). Clear Hindi labels 'नागरिक राष्ट्रवाद' and 'जातीय राष्ट्रवाद'.

name: ch17_part15_minority_rights
prompt: Protective constitutional cartoon showing the Indian Constitution shielding minority linguistic and tribal schools, preserving their unique cultural heritage with dignity. Heading 'अल्पसंख्यक अधिकार व सांस्कृतिक स्वायत्तता'.

name: ch17_part16_constitutional_patriotism
prompt: Modern philosophical cartoon illustrating 'Constitutional Patriotism' (Habermas)—citizens showing love for country by defending democratic values, human rights, and the Constitution. Heading 'संवैधानिक देशभक्ति'.

name: ch17_part17_sports_science_pride
prompt: Exhilarating cartoon showing positive national pride: Indian athletes winning Olympic medals and scientists celebrating the Chandrayaan moon landing under the Tricolor. Heading 'राष्ट्रीय गौरव: खेल और विज्ञान'.

name: ch17_part18_digital_cyber_nationalism
prompt: High-tech educational cartoon showing India's digital sovereignty: UPI payment grid, semiconductor manufacturing, and cybersecurity shield protecting citizens from disinformation. Heading 'डिजिटल राष्ट्रवाद व साइबर संप्रभुता'.

name: ch17_part19_global_cooperation
prompt: Global cooperation cartoon showing India extending humanitarian vaccine and disaster relief aid to the world while protecting national security. Banner 'राष्ट्रहित और विश्व बंधुत्व: वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्'.

name: ch17_part20_grand_conclusion_nationalism
prompt: Grand patriotic conclusion cartoon. The golden Ashoka Lion Capital and Constitution book shining in the center, surrounded by 140 crore united Indian citizens (farmers, soldiers, students, doctors, teachers) holding hands. Banner 'समावेशी राष्ट्रवाद ही अखंड भारत की आत्मा' and 'सत्यमेव जयते'.
